websites.title: Websites or domains
websites.description: Company websites or domains, one per line: stripe.com, https://www.hubspot.com, or even an email like info@acme.com (the domain is used). Duplicates are removed.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus contact, about, imprint and careers pages. More pages find more contacts; 4 is a good balance.

includeTechStack.title: Detect tech stack
includeTechStack.description: Detect 130+ technologies (CMS, ecommerce, analytics, marketing automation, ad pixels, chat, frameworks, CDN, payments, consent).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel websites
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to process at the same time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed for most sites. Enable Apify Proxy only if many sites return HTTP 403 (bot protection).
